name: Ceiling Fan
instruction: Could you create a ceiling fan for me? It should have three blades and be mounted on a short rod. The blades should be evenly spaced and slightly curved.

Shape accuracy: The blades are evenly spaced around the central hub.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The blades are proportionate to the size of the fan's hub.
The length of the rod is proportionate to the overall height of the fan.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The blades are mounted evenly around the central hub.
The fan is properly oriented for ceiling installation.
The rod supports the fan at an appropriate height.
Object distance and contact: The blades do not overlap with each other.
There is adequate space between the blades and the ceiling.
The rod connects securely to the fan hub.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes are accurately represented.
The design adheres to the requirement of three blades.
The blades are mounted on a short rod as instructed.
